package.author: hongfaqiu
package.description: A desktop workspace for local inference with Strata: prepare the runtime, manage models and services, and monitor your local API.

en-US.author: hongfaqiu
en-US.description: A desktop workspace for local inference with Strata: prepare the runtime, manage models and services, and monitor your local API.
en-US.longDescription: Strata Manager is an open-source desktop app for managing Niko1221/Strata, a local LLM inference engine. It bundles runtime setup, model downloads, service controls, streaming chat, hardware and API usage monitoring, task-based tuning, and benchmarking into a single workspace. Model weights already on your machine stay untouched.
en-US.name: Strata Manager
en-US.releaseNotes: - Set GGML_NO_BACKTRACE=1 on engine child processes: matches upstream 38ad0bc. ggml's abort path may fork gdb/lldb and write debugger errors into the engine log and the picture reader's READY pipe. Starting a service through serve.server, running setup.py tasks, reading engine --help, and the upgrade trial --version now set the variable in the child environment only (an existing value is left alone; STRATA_BACKTRACE leaves it unset). Manager's own process environment is unchanged.

zh-CN.description: 面向 Strata 本地推理的桌面工作台。
zh-CN.longDescription: Strata Manager 是一款面向 Niko1221/Strata 本地大模型推理引擎的开源桌面管理工具，将运行环境准备、模型配置、服务控制、聊天、监控、调优与基准测试整合到同一工作台，降低使用门槛。已下载的模型权重不会被改动。
zh-CN.releaseNotes: - 启动子进程时设置 GGML_NO_BACKTRACE=1：对齐上游 38ad0bc。ggml 异常路径可能拉起 gdb/lldb，把调试器报错写进引擎日志和读图进程的 READY 管道。现在经 serve.server 启动服务、运行 setup.py 任务、读取引擎 --help、以及升级试启动 --version 时，只在子进程环境设置该变量（已有值不覆盖；设置了 STRATA_BACKTRACE 时不设）。不改变 Manager 自身进程环境。
